manifest.goal: Develop the full fractal token-native HSWM by identifying the next testable contribution of outcome-bound relation revision.

sources.title: Actual USL relation instrument result and limitations
OpenAI reported research method; stronger internal discovery model, Astra formalization

hypotheses.claim: An outcome-bound relation revision can improve a later unseen task beyond the same model with the same available history and budget.
hypotheses.scope: Candidate research question only; current instrument does not establish independent outcome custody, G0/G1, or FCL passage.
hypotheses.falsifier: A capable matched-history native agent explains the gain, or removing the exact revision does not remove the gain and restoring it does not restore the gain.

hypotheses.claim: The apparent benefit can be explained by ordinary history, a text lesson, or a reusable program without the proposed relation mechanism.
hypotheses.scope: Competing null explanation for the same declared task family and model/tool budget.
hypotheses.falsifier: A prospectively measured contribution survives strong matched baselines and specific remove/restore interventions on held-out tasks.

tasks.question: Propose one narrow outcome-bound relation mechanism and a reproducible task where its contribution can be identified. Read the existing negative and instrument findings first.
tasks.acceptance: Return mechanism, task boundary, required observations, matched controls, falsifier, unknowns, and source IDs. Preserve final HSWM target and existing claim ceilings.

tasks.question: Independently design the strongest same-model, same-information history/text/program baseline and identify task saturation or missing native-agent capability.
tasks.acceptance: Return baseline and cost matching, expected simpler explanations, disconfirming observations, unknowns, and source IDs; do not use an intentionally weak comparator.

tasks.question: Compare both exploration results and seek leakage, task saturation, metric changes, hidden extra budget, and failed remove/restore identification.
tasks.acceptance: List concrete counterexamples or unresolved objections with source/result references. Agreement between agents is not independent outcome evidence.

tasks.question: Consolidate transferable findings and the critic objections into a bounded next experiment; retain rejected approaches and their conditions.
tasks.acceptance: Provide a precise revised hypothesis and experiment with unchanged success criteria, prospective evaluation, distinct outcome custody, and an explicit stop/reroute condition.

tasks.question: Independently check that the proposed experiment measures the declared mechanism, and identify which requirements remain unexecuted.
tasks.acceptance: Return a scoped engineering assessment with source references. A valid design is ENGINEERING_ONLY; no experiment means no efficacy disposition.
